setting: Future fully live release. Availability, funding and integration are publication assumptions, not current deployment evidence.
status: Implemented additive Market V2 candidate. No live deployment, funded reserves, production signer, or player route is established by these source files.

comparison.meaning: Comparison includes narration, headline, flow graphic and tags; a name in a tag is not a mechanism explanation.

freshness: git diff from 32859cf7 to da88c4b was empty for docs/market-v2/DESIGN.md, src/market-v2, marketv2keeper.js, marketv2solver.js and market-v2-deployment-plan.js.

mechanisms.name: Canonical base sell fee
mechanisms.claim: Canonical sells carry a 9% base Hook fee: 2% developer, 1.6% RWA recipient, 2.4% community and 3% POL.
mechanisms.missing: Explain routing of actual settled fees rather than universal transfer taxation; rounding residual belongs to POL.
mechanisms.pitfall: These percentages apply to the chosen canonical pool. They are not a universal OMR tax or the entire swap cost.

mechanisms.name: Sell-pressure surcharge
mechanisms.claim: Sell pressure can add up to one percentage point for stability; that pressure fades with time.
mechanisms.missing: Previous tag named 0–1%, but not the accumulated tick-pressure mechanism or decay.
mechanisms.pitfall: A buy does not instantly erase accumulated pressure. This surcharge is a Hook fee, not a dynamic LP-fee override.

mechanisms.name: Bounded opening controls
mechanisms.claim: Opening buys have a preset, limited window of special rules. That window cannot be extended.
mechanisms.missing: Temporary opening buy fee and optional actual quote-size limit.
mechanisms.pitfall: Per swap, not per human: splitting trades or accounts remains possible. No anti-bot or fair-launch guarantee.

mechanisms.name: Completed market observations
mechanisms.claim: The market records completed intervals of price, trading pressure and liquidity before reserve actions use them.
mechanisms.missing: Mean tick, dispersion, gross ETH turnover, imbalance, minimum liquidity and liquidity-time measurements.
mechanisms.pitfall: This is historical pool information, not an outside fair-value oracle. Same-block liquidity and incomplete genesis intervals do not establish valid depth history.

mechanisms.name: Range-bound reserve policy
mechanisms.claim: Separate reserves respond to selling and buying under preset limits, cooldowns and observed conditions.
mechanisms.missing: Stress hysteresis, directional ranges, per-action/per-observation/episode limits and qualified recovery.
mechanisms.pitfall: Finite inventory does not guarantee a price floor, ceiling or stable token value.

mechanisms.name: Core protocol-owned liquidity
mechanisms.claim: The protocol supplies Core liquidity and accounts for principal separately from earned fees.
mechanisms.missing: Actual pool position custody, idle/deployed/returned principal and fee accounting.
mechanisms.pitfall: Fee income is not principal gain; Family fee rights do not grant withdrawal of protocol capital.

mechanisms.name: Lower Cushion and Garrison
mechanisms.claim: ETH-funded ranges stand ready to exchange ETH for OMR as selling moves through them.
mechanisms.missing: Two named downside compartments and what they actually hold and exchange.
mechanisms.pitfall: Raw OMR-per-ETH ticks run opposite an ETH-per-OMR price chart. A downside range is above the raw reference tick.

mechanisms.name: Upper Cushion and Desk
mechanisms.claim: OMR-funded ranges supply OMR as buying moves through them.
mechanisms.missing: Two named upside compartments and their inventory direction.
mechanisms.pitfall: The Market V2 Desk tranche is distinct from the in-game recycled-inventory Desk. An upside range is below the raw reference tick.

mechanisms.name: War Chest
mechanisms.claim: The War Chest holds real reserve inventory for qualified replenishment.
mechanisms.missing: It does not deploy a range directly. Surge, inventory-bond proceeds and arbitrage reserve shares fund its separate adapter.
mechanisms.pitfall: Depositing more assets does not reset capacity; recovering prices do not create reserves.

mechanisms.name: Inventory bonds
mechanisms.claim: A bond purchases already funded OMR with ETH and releases a reserved entitlement over time.
mechanisms.missing: Purchase/epoch/lifetime limits in both assets, absolute rate bound, immediate reservation, nontransferability and independent vested claims.
mechanisms.pitfall: No mint authority, sellback promise, guaranteed discount or guaranteed return. Canonical sell fee still applies when vested OMR is sold.

mechanisms.name: Arbitrage participation
mechanisms.claim: A solver commits a specific trade cycle, then executes it only if realized profit clears its required threshold.
mechanisms.missing: Atomic two-pool cycle, solver-bound commit/reveal, reserve share, collateral claims and fee/gas-aware planning.
mechanisms.pitfall: No exclusive arbitrage, private orderflow or guaranteed profit. A failed transaction can still cost gas.

mechanisms.name: Seasonal Family Turf
mechanisms.claim: A Family's Turf grants rights to future funded fees from a designated seasonal liquidity range.
mechanisms.missing: Fixed price slabs and explicit lane/controller/bridge custody topology.
mechanisms.pitfall: Turf is a fee entitlement, not possession of LP principal or a promise of a payout.

mechanisms.name: Syndicates
mechanisms.claim: Up to four Families can share a Turf's future fee rights under a fixed split.
mechanisms.missing: At most four recipients; shares must total 10,000 basis points; prospective ownership.
mechanisms.pitfall: No retroactive transfer of already credited fees; no invented profit multiplier for alliance size.

mechanisms.name: Sieges
mechanisms.claim: During a siege, actual fees enter escrow under frozen participant wallets and configured outcome rules.
mechanisms.missing: Bounded duration/victory allocation, frozen recipients, expected revision/epoch and replay-safe resolution.
mechanisms.pitfall: Winning does not necessarily take all escrow. Nothing permits seizing LP principal or creating unfunded fees.

mechanisms.name: Corridors, loyalty and fortification
mechanisms.claim: Adjacent ranges with matching owners can form corridors; loyalty and fortification record game status.
mechanisms.missing: These named territorial status mechanics were absent.
mechanisms.pitfall: Status never multiplies a monetary claim. Do not draw a yield boost beside fortification.

mechanisms.name: Historical fee ownership and checkpoints
mechanisms.claim: Fees earned before a transfer are checkpointed before future rights change hands.
mechanisms.missing: Atomic collection/forwarding before ownership, siege or treasury transitions; historical credits stay with their recipients.
mechanisms.pitfall: The cutoff is the actual onchain checkpoint, not an inferred earlier gameplay timestamp. A failed source may delay a treasury-wallet change.

mechanisms.name: Player LP commitments
mechanisms.claim: Commit an eligible canonical liquidity-position NFT for a finite term; qualifying depth draws rewards from a funded campaign.
mechanisms.missing: Two distinct fresh observations, conservative sampled depth-time, invalid-gap/pause breaks, first-come checkpoint funding and independent maturity withdrawal.
mechanisms.pitfall: No guaranteed yield or continuous depth proof. Empty, foreign-pool, subscribed and previously committed NFTs are rejected.

mechanisms.name: Bounded keepers
mechanisms.claim: Keepers carry out a narrow set of checked maintenance jobs with bounded gas and transaction scope.
mechanisms.missing: Pinned one-block reads, simulation, runtime verification, one new transaction per invocation and durable reconciliation.
mechanisms.pitfall: A keeper is not an unrestricted AI agent, does not schedule itself, and cannot be described as running endlessly by itself.

mechanisms.name: Deployment, binding and funding plan
mechanisms.claim: Each market component has an explicit binding, funding source and authority boundary.
mechanisms.missing: Offline constructor/address calculation, initialization, recipient custody, binding and funding transactions.
mechanisms.pitfall: Example deployment inputs are local-chain fixtures, not the actual launch price, liquidity or reserve budget. Do not say source presence activates the release.

mechanisms.name: Fee currency, partial fills and LP fees
mechanisms.claim: Fees follow what actually settles, in ETH or OMR. Pool LP fees are separate.
mechanisms.missing: Exact-input/exact-output fee-currency selection and actual partial-fill deltas.
mechanisms.pitfall: Do not animate every fee as ETH or charge the fee against an unfilled order's requested amount.

mechanisms.name: Independent immutable recipient buckets
mechanisms.claim: Each fee recipient claims its own bucket independently.
mechanisms.missing: Fixed recipients/rates/policy; recipient failure does not block swaps or unrelated claims; a recipient can choose its claim destination.
mechanisms.pitfall: Independence of fee claims does not mean every operation is failure-independent: all-lane wallet checkpointing has explicit coupling.

mechanisms.name: Canonical venue scope and transfer-tax interlock
mechanisms.claim: This Hook's policy applies to its canonical ETH/OMR pool; other venues have their own rules.
mechanisms.missing: Alternative unhooked pools are possible. PoolManager must not also be registered for OMR transfer tax.
mechanisms.pitfall: Never claim the Hook prohibits external venues or taxes all token transfers. Avoid diagramming double taxation of liquidity funding and settlements.

mechanisms.name: Core funding versus War Chest funding
mechanisms.claim: POL fees fund Core. Surge, bond proceeds and the solver reserve share feed the War Chest.
mechanisms.missing: Exact source-to-compartment routing and actual-received-asset flush; funding does not restore deployment capacity.
mechanisms.pitfall: Do not route all Hook buckets to the Family, or treat reserve funding as new budget authority.

mechanisms.name: Price-axis direction
mechanisms.claim: Label the price axis clearly: ETH per OMR and OMR per ETH move in opposite directions.
mechanisms.missing: Native ETH is currency0, 18-decimal OMR currency1; raw ticks quote OMR per ETH.
mechanisms.pitfall: On raw ticks ETH-funded downside sits above reference, OMR-funded upside below. On an intuitive ETH-per-OMR chart invert and explicitly label the axis.

mechanisms.name: Reversible range inventory and finalization
mechanisms.claim: A crossed range can trade back if price reverses. Finalization removes the converted position and locks that inventory result.
mechanisms.missing: Actual directional conversion and later-block condition before permissionless finalize.
mechanisms.pitfall: Touching/crossing a drawn wall is not an irreversible purchase or a settled removal. A price bounce alone does not mean the protocol realized profit.

mechanisms.name: Principal, fees and nonresetting limits
mechanisms.claim: Assets, principal, fees and permission to deploy are separate accounts.
mechanisms.missing: Idle assets, deployed/returned principal, earned fees, episode capacity and lifetime deployment; principal uses callerDelta minus feesAccrued.
mechanisms.pitfall: Funding or removing a position does not replenish capacity. Returned principal or fees are not evidence of fresh permission or investment gain.

mechanisms.name: Qualified recovery and partial regeneration
mechanisms.claim: Replenishment needs a full spaced observation window, enough healthy samples, and actual War Chest assets.
mechanisms.missing: Distinct epochs, minimum interval, X-of-Y conditions, gap reset, bounded transfer and exhausted lifetime limits remain consumed.
mechanisms.pitfall: No invented X/Y numbers, timing or refill amount. Do not depict a price recovery refilling ETH automatically.

mechanisms.name: One active position per compartment / explicit lanes
mechanisms.claim: Each active range has its own compartment and budget. Additional Turf slabs need their own controller and bridge.
mechanisms.missing: Core, Lower Cushion, Garrison, Upper Cushion, Desk and Turf each have at most one active position per controller; fixed Turf season/slab.
mechanisms.pitfall: Do not animate one controller into unlimited active ranges or let lanes silently share capital/fee authority.

mechanisms.name: Observation validity and manipulation bounds
mechanisms.claim: Reserve actions use fresh completed observations and still check current price deviation and liquidity.
mechanisms.missing: Idle gap handling, previous-state time integration, negative tick flooring, nonnegative dispersion, turnover-attenuated imbalance and actual spot/depth checks.
mechanisms.pitfall: Historical pool measures do not prove fair value, full-range executable depth or immunity to wash trading/manipulation. No market floor guarantee.

mechanisms.name: Game authority versus capital custody
mechanisms.claim: The game can settle typed territory outcomes. It cannot withdraw protocol principal or invent fees.
mechanisms.missing: Immutable settlement adapter, replay IDs, expected revision/epoch, Safe-created preseason ranges and one-time lane bindings.
mechanisms.pitfall: Do not imply the Don, player, AI or adjudicator has unrestricted contract control. Combat and story adjudication remain server responsibilities.

mechanisms.name: Treasury transitions and active-lane limits
mechanisms.claim: Changing a Family treasury checkpoints every active fee lane first; old credited claims remain where they were earned.
mechanisms.missing: Bound of 64 active lanes, source-failure coupling, closing/archive of expired lanes to release operational capacity.
mechanisms.pitfall: A failed checkpoint can delay the wallet change, while existing credited claims and trading remain independent. Not an all-or-nothing claim freeze.

mechanisms.name: Siege expiry and season exit
mechanisms.claim: Expired sieges have a callable default-defender outcome. Season expiry removes Turf liquidity and returns principal to protocol custody.
mechanisms.missing: Permissionless expiry through adapter; last fee batch to frozen recipients; season removal independent of oracle/pause; Safe retirement after return.
mechanisms.pitfall: Expiry is settled by transaction, not a magic wall-clock transfer. Fees earned until that removal still follow the recorded lane.

mechanisms.name: Settlement receipts and confirmation
mechanisms.claim: A territory settlement is displayed as final only after the chain's confirmation and reorg rules.
mechanisms.missing: Receipt chain, registry, season, Turf, revision, epoch, unique settlement ID and lane-scoped replay protection.
mechanisms.pitfall: Public logs are evidence, not authority to pay game cash; an animation is not a real settled transaction.

mechanisms.name: Maturity exit versus reward availability
mechanisms.claim: When the LP commitment matures, the depositor can withdraw even if rewards are unavailable.
mechanisms.missing: Reward availability is distinct from NFT exit; two-sample depth-time accounting, first-come campaign funds and timing/splitting limitations.
mechanisms.pitfall: Locking an NFT does not guarantee a funded reward, permanent range occupancy or fair allocation across split positions.

mechanisms.name: Vested bond claim independence
mechanisms.claim: A reserved vested bond claim remains claimable when new purchases are paused, inventory runs out or the oracle is unavailable.
mechanisms.missing: The purchase gate and the vested-claim gate have different dependencies.
mechanisms.pitfall: An independent claim does not imply a guaranteed resale value, early refund, buyback or token mint.

mechanisms.name: Operational separation and configuration limits
mechanisms.claim: Trading, strategy, fee claims and game settlement have separate responsibilities and explicit budgets.
mechanisms.missing: Read-only plan mode, durable signed-transaction journal, reconcile-before-new-send, daily gas budget, no legacy cash/POL booking; actual launch parameters require measured configuration.
mechanisms.pitfall: No invented reserve size, price, width, epochs, APY, reward campaign terms or solver profitability. Market V2 does not redefine RWA budgets, voucher withdrawals, leveraged Family debt, transferable future-revenue securities or DNR.

recommendedFilmEmphasis: Begin with two range inventories exchanging opposite assets as the market moves; name both cushion/Garrison and cushion/Desk pairs.
Show a reversal before finalize, then actual removal: a crossed wall is not final settlement.
Show completed observations -> bounded deploy -> capacity consumed -> qualified observations + War Chest funding -> partial refill. Keep lifetime meter consumed.
Connect 3% POL -> Core separately from surge/bonds/solver share -> War Chest, and designated Turf LP fees -> Family/siege escrow.
Use a checkpoint boundary to demonstrate old fee credits staying with the old recipient and future rights changing prospectively.
Close with funded bond/LP campaign claims and independent exits; use small operational labels for opening controls, syndicates/status, receipt confirmation and keeper budgets.
releaseBoundaries: Future activation is assumed for creative setting only. The current implementation is a candidate; do not claim an actual deployment or transaction from these diagrams.
No guaranteed price floor, ceiling, reserve adequacy, APY, profit or payout.
Use ETH-per-OMR as the intuitive price axis only if explicitly labeled and correctly inverted from raw OMR-per-ETH ticks.
The deployed interface, game adjudication and onchain configuration must exist at publication; these contracts alone do not create every player-facing integration.
Keep game cash, ledger OMR, actual ETH/OMR pool assets, NFT custody and RWA units separate.

newDraftReview.assessment: Substantively supported. All 19 implementation-table capabilities represented; deployment/binding is implicit and should be explicit. Suggested changes supplied before audio generation.

requestedCorrections.change: Use Six reserve compartments; add one active position per compartment if legible. Turf is introduced later.
Qualify conversion with price crossing an active range; not every sell necessarily traverses either deployed downside range.
Qualify conversion with price crossing an active range; same condition for upside inventory.
Add Fully converted / later block to explain finalize eligibility.
Use Average tick / dispersion and Turnover / imbalance / liquidity; avoid implying raw liquidity proves full executable depth.
Include loyalty with corridor and fortification status; none multiplies monetary claims.
Label Expiry call -> default defender to avoid implying settlement happens without a transaction.
Explicitly name Safe-controlled binding/funding and include confirmation/reorg treatment for final game receipts.

optionalDetailCards: Claims remain available independent of unrelated fee recipient failure.
A full X-of-Y recovery window is required; gaps cannot be stitched into healthy history.
Mature LP NFT exit does not depend on reward claims or oracle readiness.
Vested bond claims survive exhausted inventory or unavailable oracle, not only purchase pause.
Family treasury change checkpoints all active lanes, bounded to 64; a failed source can delay that change.
operatorHandoffOnly: PoolManager must not also be registered for OMR transfer taxation.
Use actual launch bindings/configuration, not the local example manifest.
Additional Turf slabs require their own controller/bridge budgets.
Keep immutable fee recipients, typed adjudication, Safe authority and permissionless deterministic calls distinct.
